name: Get to the Roots of It
summary: Nara Wildmane seeks Nordrassil root caps from Blackmaw Hold to study their magical properties. The druids of Thunder Bluff would be in your debt for the samples.

sections.title: Roots Below
sections.body: Nara Wildmane, a druid in Thunder Bluff, asks you to bring her Nordrassil root caps from Blackmaw Hold. The burrow leads into the hold, which the furbolg have guarded fiercely against outsiders. With the satyr situation, you can now enter. Nara wants samples of the growing roots near Nordrassil for study.

faq.answer: Nara Wildmane asks you to bring her Nordrassil root caps from Blackmaw Hold so she can study them.
The Nordrassil root caps Nara seeks are inside Blackmaw Hold.

faq.q: Why can I enter Blackmaw Hold?
faq.answer: The furbolg have guarded the burrow fiercely, but the satyr situation makes it possible for you to get inside.

faq.q: What does Nara want to study?
faq.answer: Nara wants to study the magical properties of actively growing roots near Nordrassil. Little is known about them.
